product_summary: DORNIER Machinery India Pvt. Ltd. is the Mumbai subsidiary of Lindauer DORNIER GmbH (Lindau, Germany), founded August 2005, ~17 employees, per the parent's own Locations page (https://www.lindauerdornier.com/en/company/locations/). The parent's product programme, which the Indian entity sells and services locally, is: rapier weaving machine P2 and air-jet weaving machine A2 (technical textiles — airbag, aramid/glass/carbon, filtration, mesh, tire cord, fashion fabrics); film stretching lines for BOPET and BOPP; and Composite Systems (roving weaving machine P2, PROTOS TW/TP tape lines, TRITOS PP 3D weaving line) — see https://www.lindauerdornier.com/en/weaving-machines/. The Indian entity's own catalogue/website was not retrievable (IndiaMART returned HTTP 429, ZaubaCorp 403, search backends down), so no India-specific product list or price list was read.
role_hint: trader (sales & service subsidiary of a foreign OEM; no evidence of own manufacturing in India — parent states 'DORNIER machines and systems are manufactured entirely in Germany')
comment: HS mismatch, company retained per rule 3. Declared 850110 (electric motors ≤37.5 W) and 853890 (parts of switchgear/control-gear) do not correspond to the actual product line: textile weaving machinery and its parts. Correct codes are 844630 (weaving machines) and 8448 (parts/accessories of weaving machines), with 8477 for film stretching lines if that line is invoiced by the Indian entity. Industry claimed as 'Энергетика' (power/energy) is a misclassification — the real sector is textile machinery / capital equipment for technical textiles. Trader signs: foreign-parent sales-and-service office, 17 staff, no Indian plant, revenue model is import + local commissioning/spares rather than own output. Product lines missing from the declaration: complete weaving machines (8446), spare parts and service kits (8448), film stretching lines (8477), composite/3D weaving systems (8446/8448). All of the above is corroborated only by the parent company's public website, not by any customs line for the Indian entity — therefore the product mapping is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; no customs records were checked in this task (out of scope). No CIN/PAN, revenue or export volume researched or asserted; all such fields null.
